definition.text: A torch. (1.) The father of Bela, one of the kings of Edom (Gen. 36:32). (2.) The father of Balaam (Num. 22:5; 24:3, 15; 31:8). In 2 Pet. 2:15 he is called Bosor.

lemmas.gloss: Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king
Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two
Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob

lemmas.kjv: consult, indeed, be  king, be  queen
